row.evidence: Pave's help centre documents SAML 2.0 SSO ("SSO is available for eligible Pave accounts") with users assigned in the IdP, and employee data arrives by HRIS sync; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or the developer API.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only above the free tier: Market Data Lite is free; Market Data Pro, Agentic Market Intelligence and Agentic Workflows are 'Request a quote', with Compensation Planning, Team View, Total Rewards and Visual Offer Letter as add-ons. SAML 2.0 SSO works with any SAML IdP (Okta, Entra, OneLogin, Google Workspace, JumpCloud named) for 'eligible' accounts, set up with the Pave team; no plan is named, so sso_plan is null. No SCIM: Pave builds its employee roster from HRIS integrations, and each person signs up and is matched to HRIS data by work email. The public API (developers.pave.com) is read-only compensation-planning data with no user-management endpoints, so user_api_available is false. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Agentic Workflows
plans.notes: Compensation Planning, Team View, Total Rewards and Visual Offer Letter are add-ons to this package.

scim.notes: No SCIM in the help-centre sitemap (217 URLs), the SSO setup guide or the developer API spec. Access is SAML SSO plus HRIS-sourced employee data. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: One active company API key, generated on the Connections page.

limitations.text: All API endpoints are read-only (merit cycles, merit-cycle employees, exchange rates).

user_api.notes: The External API exposes merit-cycle and merit-cycle-employee compensation data (employees in a cycle, not Pave login users); no endpoints to create, invite, update or remove Pave users.

okta.notes: Vendor guide has admins create a SAML app; okta.com/integrations/pave/ returns 404.

entra.notes: Vendor guide uses a non-gallery Entra enterprise application; learn.microsoft.com pave-tutorial returns 404.

google.notes: Named as a supported SAML IdP.

onelogin.notes: Named as a supported SAML IdP.

jumpcloud.notes: Named as a supported SAML IdP.

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS integrations sync the employee roster, jobs and compensation into Pave; users self-sign-up and are matched to HRIS records by work email.
